events.description: the calendar's own answer: items, each with id, etag (the version an update is bound to), status, summary, start, end and location, in the order they start; and timeZone

time_zone.description: the calendar's time zone, an IANA name; Google gives every time in it

day_start.description: today: the day's first instant, midnight in the calendar's time zone

day_end.description: today: the next midnight — 23 or 25 hours on when the clocks change

truncated.description: true when more events remain than this answer carries

next_page.description: when truncated: pass it as page to read the rest
